verdict.rationale: Google Voice's subscription comparison names automatic call recording ('otomatik arama kaydetme') as an advanced feature of a higher tier, so the product itself offers call recording. Nothing in the pack covers consent handling or how recordings are stored and found later. The unskippable auto-attendant announcement is an adjacent feature, not documented consent handling, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware consent or notification handling, documentation of where recordings are stored and how to search or retrieve them, in-depth first-party recording docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later
